messages:
June Park: Hey team! I'm June, joining Infra today — based in Kyoto (JST). Quick Qs: MDM & VPN steps? Also who to ask for read access to 'infra-docs' GCS bucket? Fun fact: I brew my own coffee. Two truths & a lie: once rode a motorcycle across Vietnam, can read sheet music, allergic to cats. :wave:
Maya (Onboarding): Welcome June!! Checklist sent. MDM link in email — enroll using company serial and code. WireGuard profile will be auto-provisioned after MDM enroll. If anything blocks, drop errors here.
IT Ops: Laptop assigned (R-6612). If MDM shows "profile pending", try rebooting and waiting 2-3 minutes. For WireGuard: `wg-quick up redwood` after importing conf. If you get "interface not found", run `brew reinstall wireguard-tools`.
DevX Bot: account-created: GitHub/org invite sent. Calendar: 1:1 with Kai scheduled. Slack: added to #infra and #new-hires.
June Park: Thanks! How do I request a monitor and a standing desk?
Kai Ramirez: Use equipment form: https://intranet.redwood/equipment-request -> choose "Ergo" -> priority "new hire". For GCS access open infra ticket with project `infra-docs` and role `roles/storage.objectViewer`, tag me.
June Park: Got it. Will post intro in #general later. Coffee note: happy to trade beans if anyone's into roasts. :coffee:
Maya (Onboarding): Also FYI we have a new-hire lunch Friday 12pm PT — join if you can. Enjoy your first day! :)
